parole.significato: a type of oil lamp with a restricted (jar or pitcher-like) shape and a wick spout on one of its sides
parole.testo: Borrowed from Arabic قِنْدِيل (qindīl), from Latin candēla. Doublet of candela.

parole.significato: dinar, the official currency of several countries
parole.testo: From Arabic دِينَار (dīnār), derived from the Latin dēnārius. Doublet of dinero and denario.
